entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, my agent ID is 301. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse thing. It's ridiculous. Send me a return label right now.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?

What does it matter? I want to return it! It was a total impulse buy, I've changed my mind, and I just don't use it. This shouldn't be this difficult. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager?

I understand your frustration, and my goal is to resolve this for you. I just need to pull up your account to check the purchase details. Can I have your name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
It's Mark Peterson. The email is mark.p@email.com. Look, if I don't get a refund for this, I'm posting reviews everywhere and telling everyone not to buy from VeloFit. This is unacceptable.

Thank you, Mark. I have your account here. I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor was delivered on December 21st, which was 37 days ago. Please allow me to place you on a brief hold while I review our return eligibility.
Fine. But make it quick. I don't have all day.
Thank you for your patience, Mark. I've checked our policy, and you're all set. Our return window is 90 days from the date of delivery.
Oh. Okay, good. So you're sending the label?

Yes, absolutely. Since you're well within the 90-day period, I have just approved your return request. I'm sending the pre-paid return shipping label to your email on file, mark.p@email.com, right now. You should see it in the next few minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office.
Alright, that's what I wanted to hear. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mark?
Perfect. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
